Saved Views is available today, included in all paid plans at no extra cost. Instead of rebuilding filters, sorts, and grouping each time you open a project, you can now save your exact configuration and return to it with a single click. Each team member can save up to 50 views, covering every project, client, or workflow you manage regularly, from a personal sprint board to a quarterly roadmap.

Saved Views also work well with teams. Once you've built a view that captures the right filters and layout, you can share it with your team so everyone sees the same setup without recreating it. This makes onboarding new teammates faster and keeps reporting consistent across the board, since everyone references the same saved configuration instead of guessing at settings.

To try it out, head to any list in your workspace. Your filters and layout choices will be remembered under the name you choose, ready whenever you need them again. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
